rules.fix: use LintelBrand status tokens (status.ok / status.attention / status.error) through StatusBanner or a Lintel style helper
rules.why: status colours drift between screens and break the brand palette and contrast checks; colour goes only through LintelBrand

rules.fix: use the named text token (text.title / text.body / text.help) so TextSize scaling applies
rules.why: text that ignores Text Size breaks the accessibility setting

rules.fix: one short sentence; move detail to .help or a Learn more link
rules.why: long explanatory text is not read

rules.fix: the window uses system fills; glass is for the panel, HUDs and menu
rules.why: glass on top of a Form reduces contrast and looks unfinished
